description: Manage OVH (French European hosting provider) IP Failover Address. For now, this module can only be used to move an IP failover (or failover block) between services.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: The endpoint to use (for instance ovh-eu).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The IP address to manage (can be a single IP like 1.1.1.1 or a block like 1.1.1.1/28).

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: The name of the OVH service this IP address should be routed.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout in seconds used to wait for a task to be completed. Default is 120 seconds. Default: 120

parameters.name: wait_completion
parameters.description: If true, the module waits for the IP address to be moved. If false, exit without waiting. The taskId is returned in module output. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_task_completion
parameters.description: If not 0, the module waits for this task ID to be completed. Use wait_task_completion if you want to wait for completion of a previously executed task with wait_completion=false. You can execute this module repeatedly on a list of failover IPs using wait_completion=false (see examples). Default: 0

examples:
# Route an IP address 1.1.1.1 to the service ns666.ovh.net
- community.general.ovh_ip_failover:
    name: 1.1.1.1
    service: ns666.ovh.net
    endpoint: ovh-eu
    application_key: yourkey
    application_secret: yoursecret
    consumer_key: yourconsumerkey
- community.general.ovh_ip_failover:
    name: 1.1.1.1
    service: ns666.ovh.net
    endpoint: ovh-eu
    wait_completion: false
    application_key: yourkey
    application_secret: yoursecret
    consumer_key: yourconsumerkey
  register: moved
- community.general.ovh_ip_failover:
    name: 1.1.1.1
    service: ns666.ovh.net
    endpoint: ovh-eu
    wait_task_completion: "{{moved.taskId}}"
    application_key: yourkey
    application_secret: yoursecret
    consumer_key: yourconsumerkey
